method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; NOTHING, with a NOTHING-kind tag, where it does not answer); the dates in one module, s 27 (the focus, survival) in another, the claims machinery (ss 28, 29, 43(1), 54-61, 65) in a third, and a cases file for each; one regulative rule (taking proceedings in tort against a dead wrongdoer's estate within 6 months after the grant, s 27(5)(b)) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
